name: Cadbury Bournvita Original
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Retailer FSSAI table for the 500 g jar. Other Bournvita packs list different calories/sugar.

name: Cadbury Bournvita Zero Added Sugar
notes: Trusted retailer listings confirm the 500 g Indian Zero Added Sugar jar and a 20 g serve from other shops. No complete official or trusted-retailer nutrition panel was found. Check the physical pack for calories protein total sugar fibre and sodium. Values must be powder-only.

name: Horlicks Classic Malt
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Nutrition per 100 g from Tata 1mg. Serving size 27 g confirmed on the official Horlicks India product page. Fibre not listed on the source panel.

name: Horlicks Chocolate Delight
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Energy protein and sodium from SastaSundar 500 g jar. Sugar listed only as sucrose 32 g/100 g so total sugar was left blank. Tata 1mg lists 360 kcal/100 g and a 20 g serve for a later formula. Confirm total sugar and current calories on pack.

name: Boost Malted Energy
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Panel from a wholesale retailer listing. Sodium given only as <450 mg so sodium was left blank. Confirm the consumer pack label. Tata 1mg lists energy as 373 kcal without a full per-100 g table.

name: Complan Creamy Classic
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Official ZydusMart manufacturer page; approximate values per 100 g. Serving 33 g (2 heaped tbsp) from Complan India. Fibre not listed. Closest current original Complan variant.

name: Complan Royale Chocolate
notes: Values are for powder only; milk not included. Official ZydusMart manufacturer page; approximate values per 100 g. Serving 33 g twice daily. Fibre not listed. Ingredients block on this page appears copied from Creamy Classic and should be checked on pack.

name: Nestlé Milo Activ-Go
notes: Flipkart confirms a 400 g Milo Activ-Go powder sold in India but lists nutrient content as NA. Nestlé India pages describe Milo RTD rather than a powder panel. Do not use Singapore or Malaysia labels. Check the Indian pack for powder-only calories protein total sugar fibre sodium and serving size.

name: Cadbury Dairy Milk Milk Chocolate
notes: Retailer nutrition matches typical per-100 g FSSAI values. Flipkart lists 531 kcal and 7.9 g protein per 100 g for a similar 46 g bar. Serving size is not published separately. Fibre not listed. Confirm per-100 g panel and serve on the physical wrapper.

name: Cadbury Bournville Rich Cocoa 70% Dark Chocolate
notes: Zepto listing reports per-100 g energy 598 kcal protein 7.6 g total sugars 24.4 g sodium 18 mg. Pack size and serving size were not clearly stated. Fibre not listed. Confirm the Indian 70% bar pack weight. 50% Bournville was not verified.

name: Nestlé KitKat
notes: Zepto nutrition for an Indian KitKat wafer listing: 438 kcal 6.4 g protein 35.1 g total sugars 97.4 mg sodium per 100 g. Net qty 57 g. Serving size and fibre not listed. Older pages show about 518 kcal/100 g for a different formulation — use the pack.

name: Nestlé Munch
notes: Zepto nutrition for Indian Munch: 435 kcal 6.0 g protein 32.9 g total sugars 89.3 mg sodium per 100 g. Sharebag pack weight serving size and fibre were not clearly listed. Confirm on the physical pack.

name: Amul Milk Chocolate
notes: Official Amul page for 150 g milk chocolate lists energy 545 kcal and protein 8.2 g per 100 g as approximate values and only added sugar (40 g) not total sugar. Fibre and sodium not listed. Generic Amul chocolate page mixes milk/dark packs. Confirm total sugar fibre sodium and serving on pack.

name: Amul Dark Chocolate 55%
notes: Zepto listing for Amul 55% Dark 150 g: 521 kcal 6.4 g protein 43.0 g total sugars 38 mg sodium per 100 g. Fibre and serving size not listed. Official shop.amul.com page for this SKU did not publish a nutrition table.

name: Lindt Excellence Dark Chocolate 70% Cocoa
notes: Amazon India confirms a 100 g Excellence 70% bar sold in India but no Indian nutrition table was published. Do not use Australia EU or US panels. Check the Indian import wrapper for calories protein total sugar fibre sodium and serving size.

name: Sugar Free D’lite Rich Cocoa Dark Chocolate
notes: Official manufacturer page. Energy 509 kcal protein 5.5 g sugars 0.4 g per 100 g; serving 20 g; fibre 3 g/100 g stated in product copy. Sodium left blank because the table lists 221 g sodium. Fat is listed as 0.0 g which is inconsistent with chocolate. Values marked approximate. Confirm the physical bar.
